purpose: Fixed, arm-agnostic 4-tag template that renders a modulation OPTION around a FIXED dictionary anchor for a concrete object. Same template for every arm; only the four field tags differ. Denotation never altered.
option_template: Within the fixed meaning, this object is modulated by {tag1}, {tag2}, {tag3}, and {tag4}.

rater_facing_layout.context: <fixed neutral object-function context — identical across arms>
rater_facing_layout.prompt_primary: Given the dictionary meaning of the object, which option gives a more fitting inner tendency or field around this object without changing what it is?
rater_facing_layout.prompt_plain_variant: Which option is more naturally suited to the object's ordinary function?
rater_facing_layout.option_left: <rendered template, tags from arm at left position>
rater_facing_layout.option_right: <rendered template, tags from arm at right position>

field_tag_source: arm construction spec supplies the 4 tags per (word, arm); template is identical
style_audit_hook: after rendering, all options feed the style-parity / style-tell / denotation-leakage / quality-parity audits; NO judging until all pass; global template-level fixes only
